source: GeoNames (CC BY 4.0) current settlement IDs/coordinates, South African Government, Bangladesh official constitution, Sri Lanka Parliament/Kotte Municipality, Malaysian PMO/Putrajaya authority, Singapore National Library and other cited sources.
selection: 25 additional P-class capital, judicial/legislative/executive seat and adjacent South/Southeast Asian capital cities missing from staged batches 01–18.
coordinateConvention: GeoNames modern WGS84 settlement representative point not historical jurisdiction or former village boundary.
countryCodeSemantics: Modern GeoNames codes and PPLC/PPLA/PPLG/PPL do not establish city urban rank, historical nationality or past seat-of-government.
historicNameScope: Source-grounded label transitions are distinguished from capital relocation, formation and language transcriptions. 1801 single-period baselines only editorial placeholders; not historically validated uninterrupted usage.
reviewMethod: Cite specific authority for tested changes, reserve exact fromDate for attested events, allow unverified historical periods rather than assume continuity, maintain independent settlement identities.
qualityNotes: 25 newly staged city IDs are absent from all 164 existing records; city names and IDs were compared before create-only GitHub write.
South Africa has separate Pretoria administrative, Cape Town legislative, and Bloemfontein judicial capital cities. These are historicalGeography government roles, not name changes.
Eswatini Mbabane executive capital and Lobamba royal/legislative capital remain separate; modern administrative roles do not prove first use of names in 1801.
Bangladesh official Constitution Article 5 was amended by Eighth Amendment Act 1988: Dacca -> Dhaka in constitutional English text. Local ঢাকা was not renamed by that English-orthography change.

Sri Jayawardenepura Kotte Sri Lankan Parliament inaugurated 1982-04-29; municipality states capital designation effective 1985-01-29, gazette dated 1985-02-06. Long-name period of 1985 is editorial label selection, not verified first-time official rename.

Malaysian Putrajaya 1995-08-29 launch documented in PMO speech, government office relocation in 1999. Kuala Lumpur is a separate federal capital. GeoNames city ID Putrajaya PPLG 6697380, not administrative district ID 1996552.

Myanmar Nay Pyi Taw city and older Pyinmana are separate sites. New capital constructed during 2003-2005, ministries moved 2005, official move announced 2006; earliest chosen native spelling needs further source checking.
Singapore 1819-02-06 treaty marks formal British commercial settlement, not the first human settlement on the island. Earlier Malay and other communities must not be erased.
Islamabad built as planned city after 1960; earlier namesake/adjacent communities, especially Rawalpindi and Saidpur, are independent historical identities.
All A-class historical 1801 initial names are provisional editorial selections derived from modern names; no invented dates or assertions of verified no-name-change during 1801-present.
None of these name periods automatically sets five-level historical rank, historical sovereignty or current municipality boundary. No UI/tiles/manifest app/main branch changes.

이름의 실제 개칭·문자 표기 변경, 도시 성립, 행정수도/정부 소재지 지위, 5등급 도시는 별도 사건이다.
